_comment: TEST FIXTURE for R6 (connector_owner_scope) + R7 (no attacker-provisionable wildcard hosts). Mirrors the canonical ~/.claude/mcp-gate-policy.json egress block AFTER R6/R7. Used by tests/run-r6r7-tests.sh. The operator applies the equivalent change to the live policy — see docs/INSTALL.md.

egress._allow_hosts_comment: R7: removed attacker-provisionable wildcards *.vercel.app and *.atlassian.net (anyone can register a subdomain). Vendor-owned wildcards narrowed to fixed known subdomains. *.anthropic.com kept (Anthropic-owned trust anchor; not multi-tenant-provisionable).
egress._connector_owner_scope_comment: R6: a connector matching a scope glob may only act on allow-listed resource owners. Owners are read from the payload (github.com/<owner> URLs + owner/org/organization/repoOwner fields, owner/repo in repository/full_name). A POSITIVELY identified owner not on the list is denied; a call with no detectable owner passes (the remaining R6 surface — same class as R3, documented).
